lean.quote: Staying nimble is likely the best outcome (and in my view with a slight bull bias).
lean.note: After a 3.60% gap-driven week; 'the risk reward profile favors some kind of a pullback' before leaning in.

calls.quote: Acceptance below the gap and 653 really gets me re-evaluating the situation, especially if the supporting evidence rapidly deteriorates.
To get long the most bullish idea would be a look below and fail on Wednesday's low at 671.2.
A closer look at the pathing on the hourly reveals the stack of anchored VWAP sitting right at the gap close area for the weekly higher low thesis at 659.5.
After that would be a weekly higher low pullback that closes the gap, supports above 653 and makes a turn back towards the 676.25 area.
